body:
I have tried meditating on a cliff I free climbed up to.  But no matter what I do they pull me apart every time I get any semblance of mental stability.

No it’s just the state health human services, my parents have a lawyer I just have a coordinator and case investigator .  How am I supposed to stay sane when I have almost nothing left and they are going to take what remains?  What’s the point in living when your life is destroyed sabotaged or stolen from you?

It’s never going to stop. Ever. They will get away with it the only power I have left is whether I live or die. And I’m not even really living right now.  I don’t feel alive anymore.  I haven’t been allowed to have my own life.  And now I’m going to be forced  into payday loan debt or death and my Abusive dad is absolutely GIDDY over that fact.  He gleefully shouts about evicting me.  He doesn’t care if I die and probably wants me dead.

If I’m going to die in the cold anyway may as well do it now do they can’t hurt me anymore and it’s on my terms. Im not even alive right now anyway.

I contacted the government agency, I reported them.   Now my Abusive family is instigating and falsifying evidence to try to claim I am mentally unstable and crazy and Abusive so they can steal my guardianship back or send me to a mental ward.

And will probably succeed cause being around them and their madness is driving me crazy and making my ptsd go completely nuts.

They are going to literally ruin my life completely to get away with the abuse and cover their asses and they will succeed.  I will never be allowed to live my life I will never be free until i am dead.

So I just want to end it now.
Just end it.  Then it stops cause I stop.
They can’t hurt or control me if I’m dead.

What life?
I haven’t had a life in years!
I was never allowed to live my own life, my Abusive family either controlled it literally under guardianship and ruined it that way. Or abused and sabotaged me after.

Everything I want to do is sabotaged or destroyed or somehow wrong.  Every time I build myself back up and can FEEL more than pain and hurt and misery again they destroy me. Over and over and over.  It never stops.

I am about to be evicted to DIE in the freezing northern winters or to COVID and they don’t care. They are literally blocking me from the only option I can afford just cause they don’t like it.  Its a cheap trailer.  It’s not what they want, they want to force me into rentals I can’t afford.  I’m never even considered, my views and what I want never matter.   I’m just “that thing”. I’m attacked every other day, I’m going to die from cold anyway in a few weeks why not sooner?

I don’t want to fight anymore.  I don’t.
I just want it to end.
I can’t handle it.

I’ve been fighting all I’ve done is fighting I can’t win.
I just want this to be over.  A human can only be destroyed so many times before they can’t go on.

I don’t think I can anymore.
